name: Wand of Fear

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 7 charges: Command (flee or grovel, 1) or Fear (2), save DC 15.
text: This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. Command. While holding the wand, you can expend 1 charge to cast Command (save DC 15) from it, choosing only "flee" or "grovel". Cone of Fear. While holding the wand, you can expend 2 charges to cast Fear (save DC 15) from it.
